utterances.text: Rohan.

utterances.text: Wow. Okay.

utterances.text: Good.

utterances.text: Yay, so that's sort of done.

utterances.text: Ha.

utterances.text: Yeah, but the connection is-

utterances.text: Told you.

utterances.text: Of course you did.

utterances.speaker: Rohan

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Just, what the model says versus who actually left. Forty accounts, that's all the enterprise tier we've got.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Forty, that's not many.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: No, but it's the whole tier, it's not a sample. So the average the logistic one gives them is about twelve percent.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Twelve.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: And last quarter, uh, thirty-one percent of them walked. Or didn't renew, whichever you call it.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Thirty-one.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Yeah. Twelve versus thirty-one, and I double-checked the join this time, given everything.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Huh. That's not a small miss.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Is that, like, a one-quarter thing though? Could be a weird quarter.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Could be. I only did the one quarter. I didn't go back further.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Do it.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Yeah, yeah, I will, I just wanted to say it before the thing sat in a notebook for a week.

utterances.text: Okay, sorry, I need a second. Because what bothers me isn't the miss itself.

utterances.text: It's who it's on. Enterprise is where the money is. Something like fifty-eight percent of renewal revenue sits in those accounts.

utterances.text: Is it that high?

utterances.text: Last I looked, yeah. Fifty-eight, give or take. So the model that's wrong about them is wrong about the part that pays for everything else.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: From the big picture, that's, yeah. That's the whole point of the score, isn't it, knowing who to call.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Right. And right now a quarter of the big ones are leaving and the sheet is telling the account managers they're basically fine.

utterances.text: Well, twelve percent average, not all of them show twelve.

utterances.text: It didn't.

utterances.text: So, I mean, I'm playing devil's advocate, but is this a fluke or is it the model?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Small tier. Forty accounts. Ten or twelve of them moved.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Ten or twelve is a lot of money.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I know that.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Thirty-one percent of forty is, um, twelve and a bit. So yeah. Twelve accounts.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Twelve accounts leaving, wow.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Not leaving all at once, it's, there was some downgrading in there too, I'd have to look at how I flagged that-

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Which one is it, leaving or downgrading?

utterances.text: Both counted. I'd have to split them.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Then split them.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Okay, okay.

utterances.text: Hm.

utterances.text: Or more, if I'm missing some. I really don't know yet.

utterances.text: Check it.

utterances.text: Yes. Yes. It's on my list.

utterances.text: It's a long list.

utterances.text: Okay. Can we get back to the scores for a minute?

utterances.text: Sorry. Yes.

utterances.text: What do we know for sure, and what don't we?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: We know it ran. We know twelve against thirty-one on one quarter and forty accounts. We don't know the split.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: And I don't know if the other one does any better on them.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: And I don't know about the double IDs.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Fine. So the column stays as it is this week.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: For now.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Okay. I should maybe tell Rosa so she doesn't think it's about to change again.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Tell her it's being looked at. Nothing more.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Right, being looked at. I can do that.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: And we come back to this next time, with the numbers.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Next time, yes. Bring the forty accounts split out.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: I'll send what I have tonight so you're not starting cold.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Please. And put the query in the doc.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: It's already in the doc. It's, uh, the second tab.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Is it? I never look at the second tab.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Nobody looks at the second tab.

utterances.text: I've got a call. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Bye!

utterances.text: Okay, I think that's everyone. Rohan, you're on?

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Yeah, here. Sorry, I was just- the cluster thing, never mind.

utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Loud and clear.

utterances.text: Good. Um, before the scores. Daan wrote about the cluster migration. Still September.

utterances.text: Right, he told me the same. Moving the weekly job over is a half day, I think.

utterances.text: Half day for you is two days.

utterances.text: Okay, that's fair, that's fair, but if the schema carries over-

utterances.text: No, it shouldn't. Same name, new host.

utterances.text: Fine then.

utterances.text: Chloe, you had the enterprise numbers from last time? Or was that Rohan.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Um, I picked it up, actually. Rohan sent me the notebook and I, I reran it for the quarter before.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: She did. I never got to it, the train week, the-

utterances.text: So the one we looked at was last quarter, and now I've done the one before that.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: And?

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: It's, um, the same shape. The logistic one gives them ten, eleven percent on average, and about twenty-nine percent didn't renew.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Twenty-nine.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Or thirty. It's in the sheet, twenty-nine point something.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Did you take out the doubled contract IDs?

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Yes, I used the merged-ID list Elif had. So the forty is more like thirty-seven accounts now.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Thirty-seven.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Yeah, three were counted twice. Doesn't change the picture.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: So not a weird quarter.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: No. From the big picture it's, it's consistent. Two quarters, same gap.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: And the downgrade split I owe you, I did it, it's mostly full non-renewals, like nine of the twelve-

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Fine. Good.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Hm. Okay.

utterances.text: Then we should look at the model decision again. Let's reopen it.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Good, because I did the thing I said I'd do. Pulled the boosted scores for those same accounts.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: And?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Straight out of my notebook it was bad too, honestly. Lower than I expected, which bugged me.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: How bad?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Off by nine, ten points on enterprise. Better than the logistic one, not great.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Oh.

utterances.text: But that was trained on the dirty set. With the duplicates in. So I recalibrated it on the deduplicated data, merged IDs out.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Recalibrated how, just the intercept or did you retrain, because-

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Calibration layer on top, and I refit on the cleaned training rows. Same features.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: And now?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Now it lands within about four points of what enterprise actually did. Both quarters. The logistic one is off by nearly twenty.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: And the thing that bothered everyone last time, the explaining. I built per-account reason codes. Each red account gets its own reasons, not a global list, so honestly I'd go back to the boosted one.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Wait, per account, so the account managers see why for each one-

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Yes. Top reasons, plain words. Contract end date, tickets, seats trending down.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Plain words from who? Because last time it was feature names, and Jamal's team is not going to read feature names-

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: I wrote the labels. Rosa can check them.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Show me one.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Pasting one in the doc. One sec.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Is it the second tab?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: First tab. I learned.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Good.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Okay. Reads fine. Why that one account, though, it says seats dropping and it renewed?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: That one's a downgrade, not a churn. It still flagged it, which I'd say is right.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Hm. Maybe.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: And the sixty-four against sixty-one thing, from the clean holdout, does that still hold with your recalibration?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: It moved a bit. Sixty-five, sixty-six on the decile. I'd have to rerun to give you a proper number.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Rerun it.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: I will. It's not going to flip.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Sorry, is the doc the one Marta used to keep, or the new one?

utterances.text: The new one.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Okay. I keep opening the wrong one.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Everyone does.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: The quarterly numbers, are those still the twentieth?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Twentieth.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Xavier asked me yesterday if we had a draft. I said no.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: We don't.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Right, no. I told him Friday.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Friday of this week?

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Um. Next? I'd have to look.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Say next.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Okay, next.

utterances.text: Can I go back for a second, on the switch?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Which switch?

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Going from the logistic to the boosted. The job is already running the boosted code path for the contribution table, I just stubbed it out. It's a flag.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Right, I left that in on purpose.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Then it's maybe a day, plus the table needs the new columns, and the dashboard-

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Rosa. Another hour, if the last one was an hour.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: It'll be a day.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: A day for her.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: A week for us.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Stop.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Sorry, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: What about the account managers? They've been on the logistic numbers three weeks. They'll notice another change.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Jamal said the colors were different. That was it.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: That was one message.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Yeah, but I mean, people didn't, you know, they weren't upset.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: We tell them it's a refresh plus a reason next to each score. That's an improvement they can see.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Fine. As long as it's said once and clearly.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: I can write that. Or, I can ask Rosa to.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: You write it. Rosa checks it.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: The only thing, if the first month looks off on the boosted one, can we switch back?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Same flag. It's the one I mentioned back at the start.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Good. I like a flag.

utterances.text: Anyone else have a reason not to?

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Not me. I just want it settled so I'm not changing the job twice.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Same, it's, it's the big picture, we've gone back and forth a bit.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Because the numbers moved.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Sure, sure.

utterances.text: Okay. We ship the gradient-boosted model, with the reason codes.

utterances.text: Thanks. I'll package the codes today.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: And I flip the flag when the table has the columns.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Tomorrow for the table.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Monday for the first scored run, then, probably. Probably.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Probably.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: I know how that sounds.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Rohan, send the schema change to Zofia, so it's not a surprise.

utterances.speaker: Rohan
utterances.text: Yep. Today.

utterances.text: And I'll tell Rosa. Again. Sorry, Rosa.
